content.intro: This lesson covers Excel Cell Styles and Themes as part of Cell Formatting and Spreadsheet Design. It follows the attached Excel curriculum, with an emphasis on small examples and verification.
content.why_it_matters: Excel Cell Styles and Themes establishes the workbook structure and data-quality habits that later formulas and reports depend on. A clear layout reduces avoidable editing mistakes and makes the workbook easier for another person to understand. Compatibility: Check Microsoft’s function reference for the target Excel version, platform, and update channel. Dynamic-array spill behavior and some newer functions are not available in every legacy installation.
